name: Agnes Addingworth
source: Agnes Addingworth was born into a very wealthy family. That, and her tenacious attitude and intelligence enabled her to make a name for herself in the fashion business when not many women were yet able to. Thanks to her connections and an ambitious drive, she made a name for herself, a name she has been able to grow and maintain for decades. She's now considered one of the pioneers and celebrities of the current fashion scene.
